name: Ghoul
description: A ghoul is a wretched, risen humanoid that typically serves a ghast as part of it's pack. Without a master, ghouls are mindless and will swarm the weakest prey.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: The ghoul swings it's sharp claws at a target, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, this attack causes the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Ghoul Bite
actions.description: The ghoul bites a creature, dealing physical damage. If the target is has the wounded condition, they must also make a resilience check of 9 or higher or become diseased. A creature that dies while affected by this disease reanimates as a ghoul or ghast within 1d4 days.

actions.name: Leap
actions.description: The ghoul leaps up to 2 units towards a creature that has the bleeding or wounded condition.

traits.name: Ghoul Madness
traits.description: If a ghast is not within 20 units, the ghoul has the maddened condition when deciding who it will attack, unless a creature has the wounded or bleeding condition, which the ghoul will always target the nearest with those conditions. While maddened in this way, the ghoul has a 1d4 penalty to all attacks, but deals damage equal to the penalty on each hit.
